market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has a history of extreme volatility, losing 96% from its 2021 peak to 2022 low. With the market likely in late-cycle and a bear market possible in 2026, a >90% drawdown to $20 is plausible, estimated around 15% probability. The current implied 9.5% seems slightly underpricing this tail risk, offering an edge.

Current market cycle timing suggests a potential top in 2025-2026 followed by a bearish reversal.
Even established L1s can suffer catastrophic crashes during broader crypto downturns, as seen with ETH in 2018 (94% drop).
